mstts:express-as.prosody:
Welcome to this journey where history shakes off its dusty robes and reveals a side most of us have never seen before.
You know how textbooks try to make the past feel so serious and important? Well, what if I told you there’s a whole world of wild stories, hilarious mishaps, and surprising truths hiding just beneath those official accounts?
That’s exactly where we’re headed with Shit my History Teacher DID NOT tell me! by Karl Wiggins.
Together, we’ll dive straight into the strange, the overlooked, and the laugh-out-loud moments that never quite made it into your classroom lectures.
Get ready to meet eccentric characters, witness unexpected twists, and see just how much of our past has been shaped by omission, bias, or even a touch of prudery.
As we dig up these unconventional stories, you’ll start to realize history isn’t just a list of dates and battles—it’s a living, breathing spectacle, full of human mistakes, misadventures, and plenty of humor.
So, let’s set aside what we thought we knew and explore the untold, the absurd, and the truly unforgettable together.
